Load any traits.build database into R console

Source: R/load_database.R
load_database.Rd

Works like load_austraits(), but accepts the doi of any traits.build formatted database. The doi is resolved to its repository, the relational database .rds file is downloaded to path (if not already there, or if the copy there does not match the record's md5 checksum) and then loaded. Zenodo and Figshare records are supported, as are dois that resolve directly to an .rds file.

Usage

load_database(doi = NULL, path = "data/traits.build", update = TRUE)

Arguments

doi

character string - doi of the database, e.g. "10.5281/zenodo.11188867". A Zenodo concept doi will load the latest version of that record.

path

file path to where the database will be downloaded

update

if TRUE, the record's metadata .json will be re-downloaded

Value

a large list containing traits.build data tables

See also

load_austraits

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
austraits <- load_database(doi = "10.5281/zenodo.11188867", path = "data/austraits")
} # }
